FORTHCOMING · SPRING 2025 · LEAD TITLE
Slow Fires of the Levant

by Nadia Halabi & Reem Khoury

Eighty-four recipes drawn from a year of cooking across Beirut, Aleppo, and Gaziantep — fire-blistered eggplant, slow-braised lamb shoulders, breads pulled from a tannur at four in the morning. Photographed entirely on location.

OPEN YEAR-ROUND
Pitch us a cookbook

We read every proposal that reaches us through the submissions form. We publish four to six titles a year and prefer voices we have not heard before.

ONE — THE SHAPE OF IT
Send a one-page letter describing the book, who it's for, and why you are the cook to write it.
TWO — THREE RECIPES
Include three sample recipes in your own voice, with headnotes. Loose drafts are welcome.
THREE — A TABLE OF CONTENTS
Sketch the chapters and roughly how many recipes each will hold. A working title helps.
